t: You're looking at the Reflection Pool in 25 Cannon Street Gardens, a water pool near St Paul's Cathedral. It was made by Andrew Ewing, director of the studio Andrew Ewing Design. Ewing's studio created this quiet feature, and it gives the gardens a still surface to look into. See what the water picks up, whether sky, leaves or the buildings around you. I don't have further details about when it was made or how it's built, so I'll leave you to enjoy the calm of the pool.
